# LinkedIn Publisher

Free and open source under Apache 2.0. LinkedIn Publisher is a stateless MCP connector that lets Muse publish explicitly approved text posts to your LinkedIn profile. It has no database, no scheduler, and only two tools. Drafting happens in Muse. Publishing stays behind an explicit approval step.  
For an approved Muse connector, the intended experience is simple: connect your LinkedIn account, authorize access, and publish. Developers who want to run or self host the open source version can follow the GitHub setup instructions, which include Python 3.12, a LinkedIn Developer app, OAuth configuration, and MCP setup.  
Independent open source project. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by LinkedIn or Meta.
